decisions.reason: Having remained on its own product page through 2024 after a 2023 launch, it appears to have cleared the first market test, so the option value now lies more in continued exploitation than early abandonment.

As a 2024 launch with its own page, it is still in the uncertainty-resolution phase, so real-options logic favors keeping it on the market another year while learning more at relatively limited incremental cost.
